name: Calendar and planner
summary: Calendar event files, cron schedules and day plans
author: friday-core
description: Turns plans into calendar files, schedules and timed day plans. It holds 3 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Calendar event file: Creates a standards-correct iCalendar (.ics) event that Outlook, Google Calendar and phones can import, with title, start, end or duration, location, notes, a reminder before the event and a daily, weekly, monthly or yearly repeat. Text is escaped and long lines are folded as RFC 5545 requires. Local times are read in the offset you give (default India, UTC+5:30) and written as UTC. No calendar account is used. Day planner blocks: Turns a list of tasks with durations into a timed schedule from a start time with a short break between them, and says when the day finishes. Reads plain requests like: plan 9:00 report 45m, email 20m, gym 30m. Cron explainer: Parses a five-field cron expression (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week, with ranges, steps, lists, names and @daily style macros), says in plain words when it runs and lists the next runs in a time zone offset you choose (default UTC). Follows standard cron: when both day fields are set, either one matches. Rejects an invalid expression with the reason.
